title: Sunny and the Lily Pads | Bedtime Story
description: Sonny the Quokka finds white moonflowers blooming on lily pads in a quiet pool, where a tiny green frog sits like a little emerald cushion. A magical bedtime story for toddlers from Sonny's Cozy Quokka Bedtime Tales.
narration:
Sunny found the quiet pool by following a smell.

It was sweet. Gentle. Like honey mixed with rain.

She pushed past a curtain of soft fern and there it was — a small still pool, perfectly round, hidden from everything. And floating on it, spread out like little green plates, were lily pads.

White flowers had opened on the pads — moonflowers, which only bloom at night. Each one glowed softly in the moonlight, pure white, their petals curling gently outward.

And sitting on one of the largest pads, exactly in the centre, was a tiny green frog.

He was very small and very round and very green, and he sat perfectly still, his golden eyes half-closed. He looked like a little jewel that someone had placed there on purpose.

Sunny crouched at the edge of the pool and looked.

The frog did not jump.

The flowers did not move.

The pool was a perfect mirror — reflecting the white blooms, the round frog, and the stars above, all doubled in the still dark water.

Sunny thought: the pool has made its own sky.

She lay down in the soft fern at the edge, her chin resting on her paws, breathing in the sweet moonflower scent.

The frog blinked once.

She blinked back.

The stars in the water shimmered very softly.

And Sunny let her eyes close, surrounded by white flowers and starlight and the softest smell in the whole bush.

Goodnight, Sunny. Goodnight, lily pads. Goodnight, little one.
